title: World Bloom — Link the Beats! — Episode8 Bon Appetit♪

meta.Event Outline: VIRTUAL SINGERS in each SEKAI are caring for their respective trees when they are vanished away by a mysterious light. Witnessing this, their counterparts in the space between worlds enter SEKAI to search for them.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_ppr_op4
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's see... The theater troupe me should be here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm not seeing her.
I thought I'd find her immediately since her voice is so loud.
This is sooo good!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? That sounded like...
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Mmmm!
The cheese on this pizza is so rich...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: These pancakes, Napolitan pasta and sandwiches are also all wonderfully scrumptious!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
S-So much food...!
Is she going to eat all this by herself?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I didn't realize that you were such an amazing cook, me! You're a genius!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad that you're enjoying everything so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's plenty more where that came from, so please have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Really?! I really appreciate it!
In that case... Could I order some dessert, too?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course.
How does pudding a la mode sound?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What a chic name...!
Yes, I'd love some!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sh-She's not even done ordering?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I knew she had a powerful appetite, but not to this extent...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
We're back, MEIKO.
I practiced with Len and... Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We're back!
I'm parched, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want some orange juice!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'd like an iced coffee!
*Sigh*
I'm starved.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, in that case, KAITO, you can have some of this!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO, thank you!
Salisbury steak! This looks excellent!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You really don't have to share with him, you know? I did make that just for you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, but I feel like having some Salisbury steak now. MEIKO even said that I could have some, so can't you let this one slide, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did I say something funny just now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure it's what you said...

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: There are two MEIKOs?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wh-What?!?!?!?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really...?!
You're from a SEKAI with an amusement park, MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! A big amusement park with a stage where we all put on shows together!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And we have a lot of cast members!
Miku and the others, the owner of the feelings that made our SEKAI and his friends, the plushies...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, you get to do shows with plushies?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course!
They can all sing and dance♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: P-Plushies that sing and dance...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can't imagine what that's like...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It sounds like a story from a picture book.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It really is like that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is something wrong, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh? Umm...
I think I've seen a SEKAI like that before.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Before...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You were sent to that other SEKAI by those odd fragments.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I met a different version of me there...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And I could see a SEKAI with a big amusement park in one of the fragments.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I remember you saying that...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, the amusement park SEKAI could be where MEIKO came from!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's possible!
But what are the odds of that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Truth is stranger than fiction, right?
I mean, you saw the SEKAI where I'm from in that fragment, and now I'm here!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know! Since I'm here, I'd love to hear more about this SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, we'll show you around!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You can count on us! After all, this place is like our backyard!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's wonderful.
I'd love a tour!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Awesome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, thank you for the food!
Everything you made was delicious!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I hope you have a fun time exploring this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I will! Now, it's time to go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! She's so fast!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait for us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha...
She's you, MEIKO, but also completely different.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She's got a strong personality and a powerful appetite... Oh, but you also eat a lot, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Excuse me? What was that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh?! N-Nothing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, she's so different that I'm starting to wonder what the others from her SEKAI are like.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We still don't know why she was sent to another SEKAI like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it is fun how these sorts of events happen from time to time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, where's Luka?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No idea. Knowing her, she's probably wandering around somewhere by herself.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right.
She's never around when these sorts of things happen.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll make a big fuss when she gets back. All “I wish I got to meet that other MEIKO” and “Why didn't you tell me?!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I can picture it now.
Plaza

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have to say, this SEKAI really is an incredible place.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What was it called again? Graffiti?
There's that and all these flyers posted everywhere. I can even hear singing from somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. This SEKAI was born out of a powerful desire to surpass one legendary event.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A legendary event?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! It was called RAD WEEKEND, and it was supposed to be really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone practiced really hard to become better performers. They faced some tough challenges, but they were able to keep moving forward by supporting one another!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And a little while ago, they were finally able put on an event which surpassed RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, so... The ones who helped create this SEKAI were able to make their dreams a reality?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! How awesome are they♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And now that they've realized their dream, they're aiming to stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: On top of the world? Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, just now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right on cue! That must be them!
Let's go see them, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay!
